biggest_catch: REJECTED: Toluna is NOT dead — the panel continues as 'Influencers by Toluna' after the March 2025 brand unification — but the company publishes NO concrete payout terms publicly: point values, reward denominations, and minimums vary by country catalog and are shown only inside a logged-in account. Without company-published payout figures, c2 fails.
catches: Toluna's rewards catalog is behind login; public pages state no points-to-cash conversion, no minimum redemption, and no processing commitment.
Third-party reports conflict on the basics: ~3,000 points = $1 vs 5,500 points = $1; PayPal minimums from $5 to $30 depending on source and country.
Points reportedly expire 12-16 months after earning (varies by market) — documented only by third parties.
Payouts reportedly take up to 3 weeks — documented only by third parties.

c1.evidence: Toluna Group is a real, operating global research company; its March 2025 press release confirms 'Influencers by Toluna, its proprietary first-party global panel community which continues to power agile, high-quality data collection across 70+ markets.' The panel is alive — the earlier 'merged/rebranded' concern is a rebrand, not a shutdown.

c2.evidence: FAILED: no concrete payout terms published by Toluna itself. A September 2026 review notes: 'There is no single global minimum because reward denominations and point values vary by local catalog' and values are displayed only in the logged-in Rewards section. No official public page states a points-to-cash rate or minimum.

c3.evidence: Joining is free; no participation fee found.

c4.evidence: Official Toluna corporate press release obtained (brand unification / Influencers by Toluna), but it contains no payout terms.

eligibility: Registration on the country-specific panel; minimum age set per local panel (reported 16+ in many markets). One account per person.
notes: Reject is strictly on c2 (no official published payout figures), not c1 — the panel is operating. If Toluna publishes a public rewards-terms page with concrete conversion rates and minimums, this route can be re-verified.
